items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: And when I started playing with Buddy, well, I just thought I was alright then... Well in other words, Buddy Patek was the first band you played with regularly after you came down here.

ctx.x: Well wait a minute, how old would you be then when you did finally come here?

When I came to New Orleans, close to my remembers, I was around, uh... Oh, about twenty, twenty-two years old or something like that. To my remembers, I was about twenty-two years old when I come to New Orleans. And I got around plenty of bands but I was scared to play. They'd always want to hear me play, because Jewel told them I was a good drummer. You brought your drums down with you though? Oh yes. I brought my instrument with him. And after I played with him a while, and Jewel, and so he liked it to me and…
Where did you ever meet him? How did you happen to know him?
